name: universal-desktop-bridge
description: UDB: ConPTY, durable work records and a virtual AI pointer; 60 public tools.

interface.longDescription: 60 public tools. Win32 message AI pointer with visual overlay, Windows ConPTY terminals, durable work recovery for safe operations, file and Office jobs. Existing owner permissions retained. App compatibility varies; unknown writes and dead terminal processes are never replayed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Universal Desktop Bridge Unified to check connection and complete a file or terminal task, then report its status.
